numerical_amendment_before_aggregate_res: First fold's coefficient-invariance assertion failed at 2.013e-8 under the default LSQR stopping tolerance, before any evaluation metrics were computed or inspected. Within-lineage ridge and its invariance check now use solver tol=1e-10 to verify the mathematical invariance accurately. Alpha, all features, evaluation, and the original pooled/weighted baseline implementations are unchanged.
known_outcomes: All historical cohort outcomes and headline split results, 40 random-seed refits, and lineage scoring-omission checks are already known. This is exploratory and not an untouched test set.
hypothesis: Learning genomic slopes from within-lineage variation may reduce lineage-proxy dependence and improve error on unseen lineages.
input: Existing globally phenotype-blind 80%-identity protein-family matrix (217 hosts, 9373 columns) and quantitative OD600 outcomes for all eight phages; transductive dictionary limitation retained.
preprocessing: Per training fold, filter raw feature prevalence to [0.02,0.98] and scale with training StandardScaler(with_mean=False), as in the original fixed ridge.

models.pooled_ridge: Original alpha=10 LSQR ridge, intercept, equal isolate weights.
models.balanced_ridge: Same ridge with isolate weight n_train/(G_train*n_CC), so all CCs have equal total weight and all weights sum to n_train.
models.within_lineage_ridge: Subtract training CC-specific means from scaled X and Y. Fit alpha=10 LSQR ridge with no intercept to centered values and the same equal-CC weights. Predict held-out X with mean_CC(Y_CC)+(X-mean_CC(X_CC))*beta. No held-out outcome or held-out mean is used.
models.isolate_mean: Training outcome mean per phage, no genomic features.
models.lineage_mean: Equal mean of training-CC outcome means per phage, no genomic features.

primary_design: Exact original deterministic complete-CC five-fold allocation.
sensitivity_design: Leave one of the 15 CCs out at a time, refitting all models with unchanged parameters.
primary_metric: MAE first averaged within each CC/phage, then equally over CCs and eight phages. Compare within_lineage_ridge with BOTH pooled_ridge and lineage_mean; improvements are baseline minus proposed MAE.
uncertainty: 2000 paired CC bootstrap draws of the per-CC mean error differences using seed20260919; percentile95% intervals condition on fitted OOF predictions, with no model-refit uncertainty. No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims.
implementation_checks: All hosts predicted once per design/model
Pooled original-fold predictions match saved artifact within1e-6
Adding arbitrary constants separately to each training lineage's outcomes leaves within-lineage fitted slopes unchanged within numerical tolerance
prohibitions: No dropping phages, lineages, models, or unfavorable results
No calling this an externally validated or clinical predictor
No further model search driven by these evaluation outcomes
